name: Data Mining
description: Association rule mining (Apriori algorithm, FP-growth), frequent subgraph mining (gSpan and FSG), clustering (agglomerative clustering, k-means, k-medoid, DBSCAN, OPTICS, MCL, spectral clustering), data streams (FM sketch, reservoir sampling, bloom filters, top-k counting), anomaly detection (chi-square tests, p-values, T-tests), search (k-NN queries, range queries, metric distance, curse of dimensionality, KD-tree, range tree, R-tree, best-first search, minhash, locality sensitive hashing), web mining (PageRank, random walks with restarts, ), graph neural networks and embeddings(Lipschitz embeddings, GCN, GraphSage, GAT, GIN).
